chapter_seo_title: The Eight-Nine Arcane Art - The Cost of True Indestructibility
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning learns the brutal price of the Eight-Nine Arcane Art. Trading his treasures and going into debt, he trains his body to become an Immortal-ranked treasure.
og_title: Ji Ning's Debt to the Archdemon
og_description: Ji Ning trades away his hard-won treasures and writes an IOU to master the Eight-Nine Arcane Art. The payoff? A body that no Immortal-ranked sword can scratch.
twitter_description: To train the ultimate body-refining art, Ji Ning goes into massive debt with a greedy Empyrean God. The result is a divine body tougher than an Immortal-ranked treasure.

lore_anchors.definition: The supreme divine ability beneath the True God level. It requires a Primal-level Fiendgod body to begin training and consumes enormous treasure resources to advance. Each of its nine cycles makes the body as durable as a higher-grade magic treasure, providing indestructibility without consuming divine power.

A high-grade restoration pill containing energy as pure as a Celestial Immortal's own magic power. Used for rapid breakthroughs or emergency power replenishment; worth the equivalent of a high-grade Immortal-ranked treasure each.
The nickname for senior apprentice-brother Silvermoon, an Empyrean God known for his mercilessly shrewd dealings with fellow Mt. Innerheart disciples.
A divine ability within the Eight-Nine Arcane Art that allows the user to perfectly change their body, soul aura, and even visible karmic signs to mimic any living being or object.
